snippet.title: The Pale Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
The Pale is a tense and atmospheric PS1 styled old school survival horror.

You play as Arthur, the new keeper for the lighthouse on the Pale, an abandoned island off the coast of Maine. Unlock the mysteries of the island's dark past in this 90s inspired survival-horror!

Play the demo for free now! https://vide01.itch.io/the-keeper

Twitter: https://twitter.com/home
